name: UP Matar Nimona with Tofu and Soy
ingredients: 300 g green peas, fresh or frozen
25 g dry soy granules, rehydrated and squeezed
1 tsp (5 ml) canola or mustard oil
steps: Thaw peas if frozen. Pulse or mash about one-third of the peas coarsely; keep the rest whole for texture.
Rehydrate soy granules in hot water for 8–10 minutes, drain and squeeze dry. Pat tofu dry and cube.
Heat oil in a heavy pan. Add cumin and hing, then onion; cook until translucent, using a splash of water if needed.
Add ginger, tomato, turmeric and coriander. Cook until tomato softens into a masala.
Add mashed and whole peas with ¾ cup water. Simmer 8–10 minutes until peas are tender.
Fold in soy granules and tofu; simmer another 5 minutes. Add spinach and wilt.
Finish with coriander and lemon. Adjust consistency with water; avoid adding cream or ghee.
note: A protein-boosted interpretation of the seasonal UP matar nimona. Peas contain carbohydrate as well as protein, so count them as part of the carbohydrate portion when planning meals. Serve with a small measured portion of whole-grain roti or millet and plenty of non-starchy vegetables. Vegan.
